fields.label: Abbreviation
fields.description: Short code appended to account and cost centre names, so two companies can both own an account called 'Debtors'.

fields.label: Default Receivable Account
fields.description: Accounts Receivable -- the account a customer invoice debits

fields.label: Default Payable Account
fields.description: Accounts Payable -- the account a supplier invoice credits

fields.label: Default Income Account
fields.description: Accounts Receivable -- the revenue account an invoice line credits

fields.label: Default Expense Account
fields.description: Accounts Payable -- the expense account a supplier invoice line debits

fields.label: Default Cash Account
fields.description: Cash & Bank -- the account cash payments settle through

fields.label: Default Bank Account
fields.description: Cash & Bank -- the account bank payments settle through

fields.label: Round Off Account
fields.description: General Ledger -- where rounding differences are absorbed so an entry still balances

fields.label: Write Off Tolerance
fields.description: The largest residue that may be written off to Round Off by an explicit action. Nothing is ever written off automatically. Left empty, nothing can be written off at all.

fields.label: Default Stock Account
fields.description: Where the value of stock on hand is held. An asset.

fields.label: Default Freight Account
fields.description: Where freight and ancillary charges on a supplier's bill are posted. A direct expense, not part of the cost of the stock -- see OQ-025 and DEC-033 for why, and for what that costs.

fields.label: Default Cost of Goods Sold Account
fields.description: Where the cost of stock that has been sold is charged.

fields.label: Stock Received But Not Billed
fields.description: Holds the value of goods received whose supplier bill has not arrived. A liability -- the goods are ours and we owe for them.

fields.label: Default Output Tax Account
fields.description: Where tax charged to a customer is held until it is paid over. A liability, not income.

fields.label: Default Input Tax Account
fields.description: Where tax paid to a supplier is held until it is recovered.

fields.label: Default Sales Returns Account
fields.description: Where a credit note puts what was given back. Kept apart from Sales so the books can say how much was returned.

fields.label: Default Purchase Returns Account
fields.description: Where a debit note puts what was sent back.

fields.label: Default Cost Center
fields.description: Cost Accounting -- attribution used when a document names none
